svg.text: tf.* = framework metadata + results (written by the runner) · ops / bronze / silver = YOUR pipeline under test (assertions read them, never write) · pipeline plugs in via tf.environments.ingest_adapter
Assertions (sql_scalar / sql_row / file_bytes / file_rows) read ops · bronze · silver — never write.
Runner flow: reads tf.test_cases → ingests fixtures → writes tf.test_runs / tf.test_case_results / tf.assertion_results. Idempotency: ops.file_ingestions.file_sha256 is UNIQUE.
